title: EC 1.2.4 · Similarity-aware: score distributions
caption: Distribution of test-set scores for positives and negatives, EC 1.2.4 similarity-aware split. The vertical line is the default decision threshold. SVM (RBF) on Conjoint triad: median score 0.20 for positives against -0.90 for negatives; Logistic regression on k-sep. bigram PSSM: median score 0.98 for positives against 0.01 for negatives. Overlap between the two histograms is what limits AUROC, whatever the threshold.
